data.why: The repo ships no sample gel image; agarose-gel-dna.jpg is a realistic DNA agarose gel photo for the browser to open as a local file to exercise lane detection, profiling, and ladder calibration.

goals: Open a gel image and define a gel analysis ROI excluding scanner borders and labels
Click lanes to generate background-corrected intensity profiles and compare normalized vs raw traces
Calibrate migration distance against a DNA ladder and obtain approximate fragment sizes for sample bands
Quantify band areas, widths, and relative abundance within a lane via valley-bounded segmentation
Check digested/PCR fragment sizes against expected sizes and get matched/missing/extra-band calls
Export a profile CSV, annotated PNG, standalone HTML report, and reloadable project JSON

review.summary: The tree captures what Gel Profile Studio is for and follows the README's workflow from gel ROI through lanes, correction, ladder calibration, verification and export, with mostly accurate screens and tool-neutral general labels. It needs fixes before filing: the export actions cite a screen that only shows an SVG export, band-level quantification has no feature and no evidence, project reload and quality review are missing, and the replay's screen numbers clash with the tree's.
